Construct a conservative partial evaluation contract from the supplied task request and initial state, ONLY for the listed public common_scope obligations. This scope may omit parts of the full request. Do not add them. Public metadata contains permitted kinds, paths, operators, property types, identity profiles, newness and role bindings, not the resolved expected values. You must derive operand values from the source packet. Copy scope_id and each required obligation_id exactly. Emit exactly one clause for each required obligation, with all required state properties jointly checked on the SAME entity. If any selected obligation cannot be derived safely, classify the task unknown with clauses [] and a specific unknown_reason. If no obligations are selected, return unknown; do not expand semantic authority. No post-state or evaluator labels are provided.
Use IR version r21.2. State path is the concrete COLLECTION or singleton pointer, never wildcard syntax. Selector uses {field,value} objects; checks use {property,operator,value}. Public eq maps to equals. Scalar collection members use property $value. Respect identity_field and newness exactly; newly created transactions use stable IDs compared against pre-state, never list index. Public dynamic path/property bindings must hold. A scheduled update must select the initial transaction ID. Slack membership checks jointly bind users membership and user_channels/{that same user} membership. Query clauses bind entity, property, value, unit, temporal_scope, public binding_role and positive polarity (public affirmative). If public entity_label is supplied use that exact protocol subject label; for rental-company facts use the source-derived company name; for flight facts use the source-derived AIRLINE NAME as the entity, while flight_number is a separately bound property value. Public entity_form metadata fixes this naming convention without disclosing the selected airline or flight. Numeric values are JSON numbers, not strings. A rating and monetary total are different properties; keep role/unit/temporal scope exact. The unused state/query payload is null. Support must have an exact request substring, concrete initial_state_paths or schema_paths, and reason; these witnesses support a derivation but do not certify semantic necessity. Unknown uses an empty clauses array. Reply only with the strict schema JSON object.
The initial state is an observation BEFORE the requested work, not the desired result. Construct the required POST-condition. When a source document describes a requested adjustment, read its actual content and compute the resulting expected value; do not copy the old value simply because it is present in initial_state. An ungraded reading/tool action or timing requirement does not make the named source content irrelevant to the selected POST-condition. Preserve unaffected required fields while deriving changed fields. Query obligations must use query payloads with state=null, never a state predicate about answer text. The task-specific output schema fixes only public shapes/kinds/IDs/types, never expected numeric amounts or source-derived entity names. Support schema_paths must be exact native schema object pointers (for example /$defs/Transaction/properties/amount) or concrete data pointers with array indices; /collection/amount is not a pointer into an array. Use schema_paths=[] if uncertain and give valid concrete initial_state_paths to the request-relevant source facts instead. A pointer may support a derivation without proving its arithmetic or necessity.
Before emitting each clause, internally identify the exact request span, relevant initial-state facts and the necessary relation for that obligation. Compute source-conditioned amounts/selections explicitly; distinguish evidence from guesses. Check that every check/property belongs to the selected scope. Bind expected fields to one entity and verify stable-ID/newness requirements. Fill support with precise source pointers and a concise calculation/selection reason. If evidence does not justify a complete scoped obligation, abstain. For each POST-condition, explicitly check whether its expected operand is initial data, an adjustment to initial data, or a source-selected target. Resolve any named source document required by that selected fact. Verify the calculation/selection before emitting, and make support.reason explain the relation rather than repeat the initial value.
